# case: 49-node-modules-overlay
# desc: -N overlays container-specific node_modules for the project and read-write extra mounts, skips read-only ones, and announces only the overlays it had to create

0

== docker run ==
--rm
-it
--memory
8g
--name
aic-project-<TIME>
-e
HOST_HOME=<HOME>
-e

-e
HOST_GID=<GID>
-w
<PROJ>
--mount

type=bind,src=<HOME>/.codex,dst=<HOME>/.codex

type=bind,src=<PROJ>,dst=<PROJ>
-e
TZ=UTC
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/skills,dst=<HOME>/.claude/skills
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/agents,dst=<HOME>/.claude/agents
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/commands,dst=<HOME>/.claude/commands
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/plugins,dst=<HOME>/.claude/plugins
-e
GIT_PROTECT_DIRS=<PROJ>:<PROJ>/extra-rw:<PROJ>/extra-ro
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude-contained,dst=<HOME>/.claude-contained
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/extra-rw,dst=<PROJ>/extra-rw
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/extra-ro,dst=<PROJ>/extra-ro,readonly
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/.claude-contained/node_modules-linux-<ARCH>,dst=<PROJ>/node_modules
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/extra-rw/.claude-contained/node_modules-linux-<ARCH>,dst=<PROJ>/extra-rw/node_modules
claude-contained:latest
/usr/local/bin/shell-run
